· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($397.83/$369.03): confirming weakening long-term trend.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.1→38.1) + entering oversold territory, weak momentum persists.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.3938→-1.3938) + weak convergence holding, minimal trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $333.71) + 23.58% band width suggests potential volatility expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($359.49) + potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (range-bound) + lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.04x) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation zone) + wait-and-see conditions met, awaiting buy entry.
